risks.title: Uncertainty regarding going concern
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed first in Item 1A, highly intense language ("substantial doubt", "going concern"), accumulated deficit of $17.4M and negative operating cash flows of $2.9M as of September 30, 2025. Trend stable but critical to business viability.

risks.title: Critical dependence on student recruitment and retention
risks.score_rationale: Risk repeated three times in Item 1A ("critical to continued success"), highly intense language. Business model entirely reliant on student enrollment numbers. Lack of customer diversification explicitly stated.

risks.title: PRC regulatory risk on education and foreign investments
risks.score_rationale: Major risk spanning 3+ paragraphs, highly intense language ("material adverse effect", "significantly decline or be worthless"). Explicit reference to the July 2021 "double reduction" policy that impacted US-listed education companies. Trend up: new restrictions expected.

risks.title: Unpredictability of Chinese legal and regulatory framework
risks.score_rationale: Detailed risk over 2+ paragraphs, intense language ("little advance notice", "substantial uncertainty"). PRC administrative system based on unpublished directives with potential retroactive effect. Trend stable but structural.

risks.title: Dependence on relationships with local governments and Chinese schools
risks.score_rationale: Business model-specific risk, moderately intense language ("rely heavily", "critical"). EpicQuest depends on provincial/local governments, school principals and teachers to promote its programs. Trend stable but structural.

risks.title: Impact of pandemics on demand for educational travel
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk (travel/overseas education), moderately intense language ("may continue to be affected"). COVID-19 has already impacted operations. Trend up: risk of future pandemics.

risks.title: Restrictions on foreign currency transfers and fund repatriation in PRC
risks.score_rationale: China-specific operational risk, moderate language ("may restrict", "may not be able"). PRC controls on RMB convertibility and fund remittances. Trend stable but structural.

risks.title: Significant fluctuations in quarterly operating results
risks.score_rationale: Business risk related to seasonality and customer concentration, moderate language ("may fluctuate significantly"). Revenue of $8.9M in 2025 with volatility. Trend stable but inherent to the model.

ai_positioning.summary: EEIQ adopts an integrated approach to AI, combining traditional teaching with AI tools to enhance learning and engagement. The company is developing a globalized AI-powered educational platform and has launched AI certification programs.
